Subject: Redwood Penetration Test — Findings & Evidence Request

Hi Connor,

Attached is the draft penetration test report (acme_pt_findings_20260720.pdf) from our external vendor. There are 18 findings flagged as high/med-risk that the assessor has requested evidence for remediation steps and dates.

Can you please:
- Confirm the owners for the affected services (we included service IDs in Appendix A)
- Provide evidence artifacts (remediation tickets, config snapshots, patch records, and test re-runs) where available
- Let us know estimated delivery dates for the evidence

We'd like to close the loop with audit next week. If helpful, we're available for a 30m call later today.

Thanks,

Patrick Sanders
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: acme_pt_findings_20260720.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood Penetration Test — Findings & Evidence Request

Thanks Patrick — got the report and appreciate the summary.

Evelyn / Marissa: can you take ownership of triaging the items that map to infra/serving runtime and app/frontend respectively? Below are the artifacts we'll need from each team (if any of these are already collected, please drop the locations):

- Remediation ticket IDs + links (Jira)
- Post-patch configuration snapshot (sysctl, firewall rules, runtime flags)
- Build/release artifact hash and pipeline run (CI link)
- Re-test evidence (scan output / screenshots / assessor verification comments)
- Owner-assigned ETA for each high/medium finding

Patrick — can you confirm whether audit needs signed statements or raw artifacts? We'll aim to turn around the first tranche by EOD tomorrow.

-Connor

Connor O'Brien
Technical Program Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Evelyn Hart
